summary: [[character:riker]], [[character:homer]], [[character:charles]] and [[character:ralph]] drift half a kilometer from the first two colony ships to watch their final assembly in person, though they had agreed a drone feed would be just as good; even [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]] had considered taking a shuttle up. Construction had been balanced so both ships reached the same stage together, and only the connection of the drive rings to the hull remained. Every [[organization:united-nations|UN]] delegate streams the event, and the UN sensibly skips the speeches. When the construction [[technology:ami]] reports all connections successful, the two colony ships, officially [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]], are complete, and Riker finds himself tearing up. Afterwards he talks by video with [[character:julia-hendricks]] and her family, his sister's descendants, for whom these calls with their famous ancestor have become routine; seeing them makes him feel more real than [[technology:vr]] does. He outlines the remaining system, integration and stress tests and the shakedown cruise. Julia's family and the Spits group will travel on [[vessel:exodus-3]], a promise Riker obtained from [[character:cranston|Cranston]] before agreeing to his proposal, while about three hundred people who cannot fit aboard will be first onto the fourth ship, with established homes guaranteed at [[location:omicron2-eridani]]; Cranston asked for volunteers and got them. Julia is glad the old fear that hers might be [[species:human|humanity]]'s last generation did not come true, and her young son [[character:justin-hendricks|Justin]], one of the newest members of Clan Bob, laughs at the face his uncle William makes.

introducing.name: Ralph
introducing.current_state: At [[location:sol]], he watches the final assembly of the first two colony ships in person with [[character:riker]], [[character:homer]] and [[character:charles]].

introducing.name: Justin Hendricks
introducing.current_state: A young child, son of [[character:julia-hendricks]] and one of the newest members of Clan Bob. He sits on his mother's lap during her video calls with [[character:riker]], whom he loves as his uncle William, and he and his family are to travel on [[vessel:exodus-3]].

introducing.name: Exodus-1
introducing.description: A [[vessel:use-colony-ship]], officially named Exodus-1, built at [[location:sol]] alongside [[vessel:exodus-2]] as the first two ships of the colony fleet.
introducing.current_state: Complete after the final connection of its drive rings to the hull, which the construction [[technology:ami]] reported successful; system, integration and stress tests and a shakedown cruise remain.

introducing.name: Exodus-2
introducing.description: A [[vessel:use-colony-ship]], officially named Exodus-2, built at [[location:sol]] alongside [[vessel:exodus-1]] as the first two ships of the colony fleet.
introducing.current_state: Complete after the final connection of its drive rings to the hull, which the construction [[technology:ami]] reported successful; system, integration and stress tests and a shakedown cruise remain.

introducing.name: Exodus-3
introducing.description: The third [[vessel:use-colony-ship]], known earlier as ship three, following [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]].
introducing.current_state: Still to follow the first two ships, carrying the Spitsbergen group, [[character:julia-hendricks]]'s family and [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]'s enclave; about three hundred people who cannot fit aboard will go first on the fourth ship.

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]], he has seen [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]] completed and plans their tests and shakedown cruise. Regular video calls with the Hendricks household, his sister's descendants, make him feel real.

Treating [[character:riker]] as a relative, she talks with him by video regularly and calls him Will, often with her family and young son [[character:justin-hendricks|Justin]] around her. Her family is to travel on [[vessel:exodus-3]].

His deal trading [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]'s food surplus for the rest of ship three's places stands, on [[character:riker]]'s condition that the Hendricks family and the Spits ride [[vessel:exodus-3]]. He has found volunteers to go first on the fourth ship, with homes guaranteed at [[location:omicron2-eridani]].

[[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]] are complete and await tests and a shakedown cruise. [[vessel:exodus-3]] is assigned to the [[organization:spitsbergen-refuge]], the Hendricks family and [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]'s enclave, and its overflow will go first on a fourth ship.
Every delegate followed the completion of [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]] by video stream, and the assembly decided against making speeches for the occasion.
